sources.title: Date Palm Pests and Diseases: Integrated Management Guide
sources.rights_evidence: The guide is identified as CC BY-SA 4.0. Source text may be cited and adapted with attribution and share-alike compliance; individual photographs/figures and any training use still require item-level verification before copying or ingestion.
sources.notes: Core regional date-palm reference; does not establish disease prevalence in Oman.

sources.title: AESA Based IPM Package — Citrus
sources.publisher: National Institute of Plant Health Management, India
sources.rights_evidence: Publicly accessible technical guide; no blanket image-reuse or commercial model-training permission established. Cite factual summaries and verify reuse terms for every figure.
sources.notes: Citrus pest and disease IPM reference; transfer recommendations only after local validation.

sources.title: Integrated Pest Management for Citrus
sources.publisher: University of California Statewide IPM Program
sources.rights_evidence: Copyrighted extension publication. Use bibliographic citations and independently written factual summaries; do not copy figures or text into training material without permission.
sources.notes: Useful differential diagnosis and IPM context; not an Oman pesticide recommendation.

sources.title: A Guide to Citrus Disease Identification (CH159)
sources.rights_evidence: Extension publication with image credits and reuse terms requiring item-level review. Public availability is not treated as permission for image redistribution or commercial training.
sources.notes: Photographic reference for symptom comparison; verify each image's credit and licence.

sources.title: EPPO Global Database
sources.publisher: European and Mediterranean Plant Protection Organization
sources.rights_evidence: Database content and individual media assets may have separate terms. Record citations and verify asset-specific permissions before reuse or training.
sources.notes: Scientific names, synonyms, host range and country-level occurrence records; each occurrence needs its own dated citation.

sources.title: Diseases of date palm leaves dataset (Version 2)
sources.publisher: Namoun, Alkhodre, Abi Sen, Alsaawy and Almoamari; Mendeley Data
sources.rights_evidence: Mendeley Data Version 2 page explicitly identifies Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Commercial reuse is permitted subject to licence conditions, attribution, indication of changes, and no additional restrictions. Retain the dataset citation and verify any third-party material separately.

dataset_facts.capture_subject: date palm leaves and leaflets; not fruits, trunks or roots

sources.notes: Use original/raw images as primary independent samples. Processed/cropped/augmented derivatives must be linked to their parent specimen and kept in the same data split to prevent leakage. Saudi field images are regional reference evidence, not proof of prevalence or identical presentation in Oman. Labels require agronomic review before model training.

sources.title: Image dataset of infected date palm leaves by Dubas insects (Version 2)
sources.rights_evidence: Mendeley Data Version 2 record identifies Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0). Commercial reuse is permitted subject to licence conditions, attribution, indication of changes, and no additional restrictions. Verify third-party components separately.
sources.notes: The dataset supports recognition of visible Dubas-related insects and honeydew patterns, but its four labels are not a complete severity scale or species-level diagnostic key. Preserve camera/source metadata and keep drone and close-up image tasks distinguishable. Iraqi field images are not proof of prevalence in Oman; local validation and expert review are required.
